Deep Cleaning

What's included

Regular cleaning keeps a space tidy; deep cleaning resets it. We go beyond the usual surfaces to the places that collect dust and grime over months.

  • Baseboards, vents and door frames
  • Inside cabinets and appliances on request
  • Restroom descaling and grout cleaning
  • Floors scrubbed, not just mopped
  • High dusting: fans, ledges and fixtures
  • Post-renovation dust removal

Ideal for

  • Spring and seasonal cleaning
  • After renovation or construction
  • Before inspections or events
  • Move-in and move-out

  1. 1

Frequently asked questions

How long does a deep clean take?

It depends on size and condition. We give you an estimate during the free walkthrough.

Do you clean after construction?

Yes. We remove fine construction dust and debris so the space is ready to use.

Is deep cleaning the same as regular cleaning?

No. Deep cleaning covers areas that regular service does not, so it takes longer and is usually done a few times a year.
